pages.title: Connection
pages.text: Join a $(l:siliconic:logistics_controller)logistics controller$(/l) to chests and machine inventories with logistics pipes. The controller lists accessible inventory faces as ports.$(br2)Power cables carry energy; logistics pipes provide routes for items.

pages.title: Route checks
pages.text: Configure source and destination ports in the controller on the same pipe network. Every chunk on the route must be loaded.$(br2)After connecting equipment, check the port list and any access rules on the machine face.
